Body.Content:
Users can now manually access saved credentials when password suggestions don't appear automatically. When a user right-clicks a recognized username or password field, a new Select Password option appears in the context menu. This provides a reliable fallback path for sign-in scenarios where autofill suggestions are not surfaced, reducing the need for users to copy credentials manually. No configuration is required, and existing password management policies continue to apply.

GA date: November CY2026
